anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in the picturesque Schoemanshoek Valley, Surval Boutique Olive Estate offers an intimate escape where 18th-century charm meets modern luxury. Experience serene olive groves, breathtaking Swartberg Mountain views, and elegant accommodations designed for ultimate relaxation. Indulge in exquisite dining, personalized service, and a tranquil atmosphere that invites you to unwind. Perfectly positioned for exploring Oudtshoorn's natural wonders, from the Cango Caves to wildlife encounters, Surval provides an authentic Karoo experience that feels both grand and intimately welcoming. Discover a true sanctuary where every detail is crafted for your comfort and delight.
